title: Worldhewn - A solo classic-style offline "mmo" with up to 2400 AI Players
author: travisrd
selftext:
Worldhewn is built in Godot 4.7 with GDscript and pretty much all of it has been made with Claude Opus 5.5 on high.  I split the work into "Waves"  
Blender MCP

Qwen3 through llama.cpp as an optional for a bit smarter chat.

Its taken about 2 months to get this far, here's a pretty basic trailer overview of the game.   Still so much to do, but its been a lot of fun

comments.author: Josh-Wood88
comments.body: the classic MMO atmosphere comes through nicely in the trailer looking forward to seeing how the NPC interactions develop

comments.author: DungeonTurn
comments.body: Super curious what this runs on - I think it looks great!

comments.author: yukajii
comments.body:
What makes the AI players distinct from regular NPCs? 

This sounds like the unique selling point of the game, so I'd love to hear more about that.

Do you use some kind of local model like JEV for decision making?

replies.author: travisrd
replies.body:
There's quite a few changes, regular npcs don't really provide much interaction minus providing quests/vendors or guards attacking mobs that get too close to city gates etc. but the ai players each have their own class, level, gear, personality, they level up like normal, travel roads between towns, they'll be in dungeons, or making trades on the auction house with loot they found in world.   

In-game you can build your own group comp, so I can look at party board and see which other players are lfg around my level and invite a tank or a healer, a dps and a crowd controller up to 5 players.  They will hold conversations about anything all though at times can be pretty dumb, they have great memory though.  If I need for something that's not an upgrade, party members may ask for it if its actually an upgrade for them.  There will be random ai players looking for ports or offering ports for a tip,  if i whisper someone offering a port they will invite me to party and port me where I want.  Each ai player has their own personality, some may be grumpy or very kind, they will warm up to you overtime based on your interactions and remember past conversations.  

If I see a high level in town I can ask them specifically for a certain buff or ask for directions to the auction house or whatever.  

  
Its still extremely buggy of course but tweaking it as I play and its coming along slowly

comments.author: Rhytmik
comments.body: As someone making myself an offline mmo with ai teammates, thank you for showings its possible. Mine will never be as complicated as yours but that gives me more motivation to see mine through.
